title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 319 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)

Doing anything fun today? 💛🌎

A broad dark coronal-hole region is visible near the Sun’s center, alongside a few small sunspots and bright coronal regions.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
